title: Create putaway template bin validation
summary: Put-away template bin validation now excludes receipt, shipment, and posted receipt-line bins to ensure only compliant bins are selected for put-away operations.
key_points: Receipt, shipment, and posted receipt-line bins are excluded from put-away template searches
Create Put-away now selects valid eligible bins matching template criteria instead of falling back to non-compliant bins
Regression test added to verify correct bin selection behavior
No breaking changes or compatibility risks
